name: National Library of Romania
elevationDatum: Rigid local foundation y=0; real metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Two mapped controls fix rotation, baked into the geometry once. No terrain or Mercator stretch.
note: The National Library combines a long green-glass semicircular wing with a monumental pale riverfront colonnade, tiered cornices, flanking curtain walls and a glazed central atrium among four open lightwells. OSM gives 35 m with 2014–2016 field-survey provenance; no independently measured exterior height was located, so it remains approximate. Rounded-wing height, column count/sections, component cornices and atrium roof are photo-based estimates. Four small mapped inner rings remain open lightwells; the large central ring receives an estimated glazed roof consistent with the library’s reported glass-roofed atrium. Its exact profile needs rooftop review. All five mapped inner boundaries are retained, rather than covering the plan with an opaque slab. No facade lettering, public art, river, quay or landscaping is reproduced. Cityscape: not tested; Full 3D world: not tested.
